at.description: For one moment: an ISO moment, or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` on the deployment's clock.

chat.description: The room, by chat id, where it is not this turn's own.

every.description:
To repeat until cancelled, on the deployment's clock: `daily HH:MM`, `weekly mon HH:MM` (mon to sun) or
`monthly 1 HH:MM`.

memory.description: The row of this room it serves, by id or slug.

message.description: The message this call acts on: the id of the person's message in this turn that asked for it. Omitted only in a turn whose every new message is the owner's, or that no person's message opened.

reason.description: Why you are to be woken: what to do or ask then, and for whom.

user.description: Who it is for, by user id.
